g.text: Proportions: RMSE of estimated cell-type fractions (lower is better). Per-type activity: Spearman correlation with the true per-sample pathway activity of each cell type.
Leakage: share of one type's signal assigned to the others (lower is better). Each tool with its own output; PALM: posterior reallocation.
Bars scaled per column (longest = best); 1–3 = rank; – = not run. Development splits 0–9 (InstaPrism, TCA, TOAST: 0–2).
